expected_behavior: Packed storage metadata loading and verify-failure mapping must remain deterministic, reject malformed metadata safely, and preserve canonical restore/verify error semantics without silent corruption acceptance.
notes: Phase 1 survey confirms existing deterministic fail-closed coverage for metadata contracts, hash-stage ordering, and corruption-safe restore semantics.

expected_behavior: Packed container manifest/index metadata must be parseable, schema-compatible, complete, non-conflicting, and internally consistent before packed payload reads depend on it.

Packed-storage offset, length, and bounds metadata must be validated before any read, seek, allocation, or payload comparison depends on it. Unsafe ranges must fail deterministically before data reads.

Packed-storage hash/checksum metadata must identify expected bytes unambiguously, enforce supported digest format/length invariants, and reject payload mismatches deterministically before verification accepts packed content.
notes: Phase 4 hash/checksum consistency validation coverage added.

expected_behavior: VerifyRepository and VerifyRepositoryFast must never panic or silently skip packed-block verification when the container file is missing or truncated. Every read failure must surface as a deterministic physical_missing category error.
notes: Phase 5 malformed container read safety coverage added. No production code changes required; existing short-read enforcement and physical_missing wrapping were confirmed sufficient.
